changelog: Fixed migrate.php fataling with PDOException SQLSTATE[HY000] 2014 ('Cannot execute queries while other unbuffered queries are active') on every mode=run attempt against the pending backtest migrations — seen in the live error log at two different lines (recordMigration()'s INSERT and PDO::rollBack()) across two separate attempts, both the same underlying bug. Root cause: the schema_migrations SELECT at the top of migrate.php (`$stmt = $db->query(...)`) was never closeCursor()'d — fetchAll() drains the row data but the cursor itself stayed marked active for the rest of the request, and the first real prepared-statement execute() after it (recordMigration()) or transaction-control call (rollBack()) died against it. Fixed with a one-line $stmt->closeCursor() right after the fetchAll() loop.

Separately, found and fixed a second bug while checking whether rollBack() was safe: containsDdl() only checked each split statement's own leading keyword, so a migration built entirely from the information_schema-check + PREPARE/EXECUTE guarded-ALTER pattern (CLAUDE.md §3A's own standing convention for every conditional ALTER since v3.20.3) has no bare 'ALTER TABLE...' statement at all — the real ALTER text only exists inside a quoted string handed to PREPARE — so it was misclassified as pure DML. That wrongly wrapped it in beginTransaction()/rollBack() for no benefit (DDL auto-commits regardless) and is exactly what put rollBack() on the failure path in the first place. containsDdl() now scans the whole comment-stripped migration text for a DDL keyword instead of anchoring to each statement's own prefix. Verified against all 38 existing migration files: only the two guarded-ALTER-only files (2026_09_25_0002, 2026_09_26_0001) flip from DML to DDL; every other file classifies identically to before.

No database was touched and mode=run was not executed as part of this release, per instruction — this is a code-only fix to the runner itself. The four migrations still pending on live (2026_09_25_0002 through 2026_09_26_0003) should now apply cleanly once Update Now brings this fixed migrate.php to the server and mode=run is triggered.

See CLAUDE.md's new v3.21.10 section for the full root-cause writeup, including why the DDL-only migrations were never actually at risk of a half-applied schema even before this fix (MySQL's implicit commit on DDL already meant the transaction wrapper protected nothing), and the two open items (PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_USE_BUFFERED_QUERY, and whether config.php uses persistent connections) that need checking directly on the server, outside this repo.
release_notes: Code-only fix to migrate.php. No DB migration run as part of this release. After Update Now, migrate.php?mode=status then mode=run can be attempted again for the 4 pending backtest migrations (2026_09_25_0002 through 2026_09_26_0003) — this release is what should make that attempt succeed instead of fataling with the 2014 error.
